items.title: 68113_Barney Bigard oral history interview
items.q: And I had my uncle, was Ulyssis

ctx.x: Uh-huh. What was your grandfather's name?

Emile, Emile Bigard. And I had my uncle, was Ulyssis, and my father was Alexander. And Emile is from -- you see, my grandfather, that was his second wife -- my grandmother. And Emile is her son, see? So they were like stepsons with the rest of the family. Then I had my godmother, my father's sister named Louise.
Your father's sister was your godmother?
